StreamBookmark.title: StreamBookmark
StreamBookmark.description: Authenticated client-side stream bookmark synced across the user's Android devices (not a replacement for the ShareDabba website database).

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this bookmark.

title.description: Display title of the bookmarked ShareDabba stream or video.

streamUrl.description: Deep link or HLS/DASH stream URL on ShareDabba.

category.description: Content category tag (e.g., Live, Creator, Tech, Gaming).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was created (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the bookmark was last updated (must use FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/bookmarks/{bookmarkId}.description: Per-user synchronized stream bookmarks for the ShareDabba Android client.
